definitions.explanation: Relating to the ordinary world rather than religious or spiritual matters. Can describe things that are commonplace, materialistic, or concerned with everyday human affairs.

examples.japanese: {世俗的|せぞくてき}な⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世俗的|せぞくてき}な⟦{欲望|よくぼう}→欲望：05086_yokubou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: He has no interest in worldly desires.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出家|しゅっけ}→出家：11761_shukke⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{世俗的|せぞくてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧。
examples.english: He entered the priesthood and left behind worldly life.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{世俗|せぞく}→世俗：24553_sezoku⟧ (the secular world) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjective suffix). Can be used neutrally to mean "secular" (as opposed to religious), or with a slightly negative nuance to mean "mundane" or "materialistic."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世俗的|せぞくてき}な⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧ — worldly values
- {世俗的|せぞくてき}な⟦{欲望|よくぼう}→欲望：05086_yokubou⟧ — worldly desires
- {世俗的|せぞくてき}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ — secular/worldly life
- {世俗的|せぞくてき}な⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧ — worldly success

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {俗世|ぞくせ} — the secular world
- ⟦{現世|げんせ}→現世：20421_gense⟧ — this world, the present world
- {世間的|せけんてき} — in terms of public opinion, socially
